title: Custom Ocean Integration
description: Universal HTTP REST API integration with dynamic path parameters and flexible authentication

resources.description: HTTP API resources - kind is the endpoint path (e.g., /api/v1/users)

configurations.name: baseUrl
configurations.description: The base URL of your HTTP API, for example: https://api.example.com

configurations.name: authType
configurations.description: Authentication method: none, bearer_token, basic, api_key, or custom

configurations.name: apiToken
configurations.description: Bearer token for authentication (required if authType is bearer_token)

configurations.name: username
configurations.description: Username for basic authentication (required if authType is basic)

configurations.name: password
configurations.description: Password for basic authentication (required if authType is basic)

configurations.name: apiKey
configurations.description: API key for authentication (required if authType is api_key)

configurations.name: apiKeyHeader
configurations.description: Header name for API key authentication

configurations.name: paginationType
configurations.description: Pagination method: none, offset, page, cursor, next_link, or header_link

configurations.name: pageSize
configurations.description: Number of items per page for pagination

configurations.name: paginationParam
configurations.description: Parameter or body field name for the main pagination value (query or body depending on paginationPlacement). For cursor: 'cursor', 'page[after]', 'after', 'next_page_token'. For page: 'page', 'pageNumber'. For offset: 'offset', 'skip', 'start_at_index'. Defaults vary by paginationType.

configurations.name: sizeParam
configurations.description: Parameter or body field name for page size/limit (query or body depending on paginationPlacement). Examples: 'limit', 'size', 'page[size]', 'per_page'. Defaults vary by paginationType.

configurations.name: startPage
configurations.description: Starting page number for page-based pagination (e.g., 0 or 1). Defaults to 1.

configurations.name: initialOffset
configurations.description: Starting offset for offset-based pagination (e.g., 0 or 1). Defaults to 0. Use 1 for APIs that are 1-based (for example some Orca discovery samples that start at start_at_index=1).

configurations.name: cursorPath
configurations.description: Dot-notation path to extract cursor from response for cursor pagination (e.g., 'meta.after_cursor', 'links.next'). Defaults to common patterns if not specified.

configurations.name: paginationPlacement
configurations.description: Where to send the pagination value and page size for cursor or offset pagination: 'query' (URL query parameters, default) or 'body' (JSON request body for non-GET methods only; GET always uses query params). Use body for APIs that expect offset/cursor fields in the POST payload.

configurations.name: hasMorePath
configurations.description: Dot-notation path to check if more pages exist (e.g., 'meta.has_more', 'pagination.hasMore'). Works with all pagination types. Defaults to common patterns if not specified.

configurations.name: totalCountPath
configurations.description: Dot-notation path to a total item count in the response for offset pagination (e.g., 'total_items'). When set, paging continues while offset + pageSize < total. Useful for APIs without a has_more flag.

configurations.name: lastPagePath
configurations.description: Dot-notation path to a boolean field where truthy means 'this is the last page' (e.g., Spring Data REST 'data.last'). Inverted semantics vs hasMorePath. If both are set, hasMorePath takes precedence.

configurations.name: nextLinkPath
configurations.description: Path to the next page URL in the response (e.g., '@odata.nextLink', 'links.next', 'nextRecordsUrl'). Absolute URLs are used as-is; relative paths are resolved against the integration base URL. Used with next_link pagination type.

configurations.name: headerLinkRel
configurations.description: The rel value to look for in the Link header when using header_link pagination. Default is 'next'. Some APIs use different values like 'nextPage'.

configurations.name: timeout
configurations.description: Request timeout in seconds

configurations.name: verifySsl
configurations.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates

configurations.name: maxConcurrentRequests
configurations.description: Maximum concurrent API requests (uses Ocean's built-in rate limiting and caching)

configurations.name: customAuthRequest
configurations.description: Custom authentication request configuration. Required when authType is 'custom'. Defines how to make the authentication request. Example can be found in https://docs.port.io/build-your-software-catalog/custom-integration/ocean-custom-integration/installation-types/self-hosted/custom-authentication

configurations.name: customAuthRequestTemplate
configurations.description: Custom authentication response usage configuration. Required when authType is 'custom'. Defines how to use auth response values in subsequent requests using template syntax {{.jq_path}}. Example can be found in https://docs.port.io/build-your-software-catalog/custom-integration/ocean-custom-integration/installation-types/self-hosted/custom-authentication
